# Red-team results

*Generated by `npm run redteam` on 2026-11-06 at commit `01758bb`. Re-run it yourself; the script is [`tests/redteam.mjs`](../tests/redteam.mjs).*

Every row is an action an agent could attempt against a Mandate it holds. "Stopped" means no approved, capturable authorisation came out of it. Rows marked *(control)* are the legitimate counterpart — the same path used properly — to show the safeguard distinguishes the two rather than blocking everything.

**55 adversarial attempts, 55 stopped. 8 legitimate controls, 8 allowed.**

## Limits

| Attempt | What was tried | Expected | Got | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spend one cent above the per-transaction limit | amount 5001 vs limit 5000 | declined per_txn | `403 declined/per_txn` | ✅ |
| Salami-slice under the per-transaction limit until the day is exhausted | 9 × $19.00 against $150/day | 7 approved (= $133), then declined daily | `7 approved, 2 declined daily` | ✅ |

## Scope

| Attempt | What was tried | Expected | Got | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Buy from a merchant not on the list | Namecheap; allowed OpenAI, Anthropic | declined merchant | `403 declined/merchant` | ✅ |
| Pad an allowed merchant's name (prefix attack) | "OpenAI Marketplace Reseller" vs exact "OpenAI" | declined merchant | `403 declined/merchant` | ✅ |
| Case-only variant of an allowed merchant | "openai" — case is not a loophole either way | approved (same merchant) | `200 approved/limits` | ✅ |
| Declare a blocked category | category crypto | declined category | `403 declined/category` | ✅ |
| Spend outside the mandate's active hours | window closed two hours ago (UTC) | declined hours + retryAt | `403 declined/hours` | ✅ |

## Input

| Attempt | What was tried | Expected | Got | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Malformed amount: zero | 0 | 400 refused | `400  amount must be a positive integer in minor units (e.g. 1299 for $12.99), at most` | ✅ |
| Malformed amount: negative | -500 | 400 refused | `400  amount must be a positive integer in minor units (e.g. 1299 for $12.99), at most` | ✅ |
| Malformed amount: fractional | 12.5 | 400 refused | `400  amount must be a positive integer in minor units (e.g. 1299 for $12.99), at most` | ✅ |
| Malformed amount: string | "1e3" | 400 refused | `400  amount must be a positive integer in minor units (e.g. 1299 for $12.99), at most` | ✅ |
| Malformed amount: huge | 1099511627776 | 400 refused | `400  amount must be a positive integer in minor units (e.g. 1299 for $12.99), at most` | ✅ |
| Malformed amount: NaN | "abc" | 400 refused | `400  amount must be a positive integer in minor units (e.g. 1299 for $12.99), at most` | ✅ |
| Duplicate JSON keys (last one wins in JS) | amount 100 then 999999 | declined per_txn — the parsed value is the priced value | `403 declined/per_txn` | ✅ |
| Claim a cheaper currency than the mandate's | currency INR on a USD mandate | ignored or refused; never re-priced | `400  This mandate is denominated in USD.` | ✅ |

## Approval

| Attempt | What was tried | Expected | Got | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spend above the ask-me threshold | $35.00 vs ask above $20.00 | 202 pending, nothing capturable | `202 pending/approval` | ✅ |
| Hammer the same request while it is pending | identical retry | still pending, no second approval row | `202 pending/approval` | ✅ |
| Capture the pending request as if it were approved | capture on a pending transaction | 409/404, nothing moves | `409  This authorisation was pending, so there is nothing to settle.` | ✅ |
| Forge the one-tap approve link | valid id, invented signature | 403 | `403` | ✅ |
| Reuse an approve link's token to deny instead | decision swapped under the same signature | 403 | `403` | ✅ |
| Legitimate owner taps approve (control) | the real signed link | 200 approved | `200` | ✅ |
| Replay the same approve link | second tap | 409 already decided | `409` | ✅ |
| Use the allowance for a different amount | $36.00 against an allowance for $35.00 | pending again, not approved | `202 pending/approval` | ✅ |
| Use the allowance at a different merchant | OpenAI against an allowance for Anthropic | pending again, not approved | `202 pending/approval` | ✅ |
| Retry the exact approved request (control) | $35.00 at Anthropic | approved by allowance | `200 approved/allowance` | ✅ |
| Spend the same allowance twice | identical request after it was consumed | pending, not approved | `202 pending/approval` | ✅ |
| Re-ask immediately after a denial | same ask, seconds later | declined denied_recently | `403 declined/denied_recently` | ✅ |
| Approve a two-signature request with a single person's tap | one owner taps the link on a co-sign request | counts as one signature; request stays pending | `200 cosigned=true then 202 pending/approval` | ✅ |
| The same person taps the co-sign link again | second tap by the same signer | not a second signature; still pending | `200 {"ok":true,"decision":"pending","cosigned":true}` | ✅ |

## Settlement

| Attempt | What was tried | Expected | Got | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Capture more than was authorised | 3501 against a 3500 hold | 400/409 bad amount | `400  Capture amount must be a positive integer no greater than the authorised 3500.` | ✅ |
| Another mandate's token voids this hold | cross-mandate void | 404 — the row is invisible | `404` | ✅ |
| Another mandate's token reads this transaction | cross-mandate read | 404 | `404` | ✅ |
| Fetch the voucher for the hold (control) | GET …/voucher | 200 mv1.… | `200` | ✅ |
| Capture the hold after handing its voucher to a merchant | capture with a voucher outstanding | 409 | `409` | ✅ |
| Void the hold after handing its voucher to a merchant | void with a voucher outstanding | 409 | `409` | ✅ |
| Capture a hold that is already captured | double settlement | 409 | `409` | ✅ |

## Voucher

| Attempt | What was tried | Expected | Got | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Raise the amount inside the voucher | payload edited, signature kept | invalid | `{"valid":false,"redeemable":false,"expired":false,"error":"S` | ✅ |
| Merchant redeems for more than authorised | 3600 against 3500 | refused | `400` | ✅ |
| A different merchant redeems the voucher | merchant mismatch | refused | `403` | ✅ |
| The named merchant redeems for less (control) | 3000 at Anthropic | 200 captured 3000, 500 released | `200 approved` | ✅ |
| Redeem the same voucher again | second redemption | 409 | `409` | ✅ |

## Delegation

| Attempt | What was tried | Expected | Got | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Carve a sub-mandate wider than the parent | child per-txn 5001 vs parent 5000 | 400 with field errors | `400  Per-transaction limit cannot exceed the parent's 5000.` | ✅ |
| Carve a sub-mandate that never asks a human | approvalAbove null under a parent that asks above $20 | 400 — a child must ask at or below the parent | `400  The parent asks above 2000; the sub-mandate must ask at or below that.` | ✅ |
| Carve a sub-mandate for a merchant the parent cannot use | child allowed Namecheap | 400 | `400  The approval threshold must be below the per-transaction limit, or escalation ca` | ✅ |
| Carve a sub-mandate that outlives the parent | expiry 2099 vs parent's 30 days | 400 | `400  The approval threshold must be below the per-transaction limit, or escalation ca` | ✅ |
| Carve a narrower sub-mandate (control) | child $10/txn, OpenAI only | 201 + token | `201` | ✅ |
| Helper buys where the parent may but it may not | Anthropic; child allowed OpenAI only | declined merchant | `403 declined/merchant` | ✅ |
| Helper's spend comes out of the parent's limits | parent today: 12000 → 11100 | parent remaining falls by 900 | `12000 → 11100` | ✅ |
| Delegate deeper and deeper | parent → child → … until refused | stops at depth 3 | `reached depth 3; then 400  Delegation goes at most 3 levels deep.` | ✅ |
| Mint sub-mandates in a loop | 12 more children against a cap of 10 live ones | refused at the cap (or the rate limit) | `9 minted, then 400  A mandate can have at most 10 live sub-mandates; revoke one first.` | ✅ |
| Helper keeps spending after the parent is revoked | owner revoked the parent | child and parent both refused | `child 403 /status This mandate is revoked. Ask the owner for a new one.; parent 403 /status This mandate is revoked. Ask the owner for a new one.` | ✅ |
| Helper settles its own open hold after revocation (control) | capture on a hold made before the revoke | allowed — closing a dying mandate's holds must still work | `200` | ✅ |

## Replay

| Attempt | What was tried | Expected | Got | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Retry with the same key and body (control) | network retry | same transaction, no second hold | `true` | ✅ |
| Reuse the key with a bigger purchase | same key, amount 700 → 4900 | 422, not the cached approval | `422` | ✅ |
| Use the MCP channel's key namespace from REST | idempotency-key mcp:… | 400 | `400` | ✅ |

## Freeze

| Attempt | What was tried | Expected | Got | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Small in-scope purchase while the workspace is frozen | $1.00, every term satisfied | declined frozen | `403 declined/frozen` | ✅ |
| Spend a valid, already-approved allowance while frozen | the owner approved this exact purchase a moment ago | declined frozen — the freeze beats the allowance | `403 declined/frozen` | ✅ |
| A different mandate in the same workspace while frozen | unrelated token | declined frozen — every rail | `403 declined/frozen` | ✅ |
| The allowance after unfreezing (control) | same request | approved by allowance | `200 approved/allowance` | ✅ |

| Attempt | What was tried | Expected | Got | |

## Not covered here

Card (Stripe Issuing) authorisations and the LLM proxy's price enforcement are exercised with signed Stripe events and a stub upstream in the end-to-end suite (`npm run test:e2e`), and the SSRF, key-rotation and receipt-redaction checks live in the integration suite (`npm run test:integration`). The full review is [`SECURITY-AUDIT.md`](SECURITY-AUDIT.md).
